hooks.command: if [ -f .agent/code-map/map.json ]; then MAPPED_CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- app/ frontend/src/ 'tts_engines/*/plugin' 'tts_engines/*/interface.py' 'tts_engines/*/cli.py' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); if [ -n "$MAPPED_CHANGED" ]; then QUEUE_NEW=$(git status --porcelain -- .agent/code-map/queue/ 2>/dev/null | grep '^??'); if [ -z "$QUEUE_NEW" ]; then FILES_LIST=$(echo "$MAPPED_CHANGED" | tr '\n' ' '); jq -n --arg files "$FILES_LIST" '{decision: "block", reason: ("Mapped source files changed with no changelog-queue entry: " + $files + ". Per the map-code skill'"'"'s same-change rule, append one JSON file to .agent/code-map/queue/ describing what changed (schema in the map-code skill) before finishing — this is part of the definition of done.")}'; fi; fi; fi
